note: EXP-07 step 4, the L layout's north wing (plan tools/upk/plans/urb_bar-L.json: the bar's footprint, tiles x 11..37, y 20..33, plus a wing over the street at x 25..36, y 8..19). The bar stays as it is, with its baked lighting, doors and ladders. The block tested in step 3b (the bar's west block, 12 x 12 tiles, pivot (-1056, 672, 16), turned 90 degrees so that its open side faces +y) is copied north of the bar's east block, centred at (192, -576): x -384..768, y -1152..0. Its open side meets the bar's north wall (XComDecoFracLevelActor_3, y -11..11), which closes it, so the step 3b closing copy isn't needed; the wing's east wall lines up with the bar's (x 768). It copies no doors and no ladder (the bar keeps its own): the five door frames stay open doorways, one of them in the wing's north end wall, facing the street and the squad's spawn points (y -1200 and beyond). The wing gets its own building volume, with the west block's three floors of floor volumes moved and turned along; they end at y 0, where the bar's start. A hider takes out what stood on the street there: the bar's awning and sign outside its north wall, the parked cars, street signs, parking blocks, the fog pod and its effects, decals and rubble. Its box (x -380..800, y -1200..-6) stops short of the bar's wall and what hangs inside it, and of the delivery van west of the wing (its own building volume, x -687..-387). The copier logs a path from the spawn row through the north doorway into the wing, and the floor tiles at a few points. Run 27 (after run 26: no doors in the new wing, an odd gap at the entrance, decoration wanted inside, and the ground to match the layout, wood flooring inside and pavement outside): the copier copies the block's five doors (bCopyDoors, XComMapEdDoor) instead of moving the bar's own; a sixth door with its frame fills the bar's front opening, which landed in the wing's east wall; props from the bar furnish the wing's rooms; a 4-tile sidewalk ring of copied (dynamically lit) sidewalk pieces goes round the wing, over the parking stripes, blocks, the van and the SUV, which are hidden. Run 28 (after run 27: the entrance gap still open, most doors still missing (one in the top), props fine; a ladder wanted outside the wing): the street hider had hidden five of the six door copies (its class test missed XComMapEdDoor; F-36), so hiders now skip everything of the XComMapEd package; a ladder (visible copy plus a hidden climbing ladder) goes outside the wing's north wall. Run 29 (after run 28: doors are in, but the doors can't be opened, the ladder can't be climbed and the windows can't be run through, the entrance gap is just a gap in the wall into the new wing, and the north-west room's floor should be wood): door copies work out bMustDestroy after copying (F-37); the entrance door goes into the bar's front doorway, which is the gap; a scaled wood floor covers the wing; the wing's and the ladder's copiers rebuild their tiles again 4 s after load; probes for the ladder, the doorway and the windows. Run 30 (after run 29: the entrance gap still there, the inner wall's end should be a full wall too, doors and windows still can't be used, the ladder still can't be climbed, its foot tile not walkable): wall copies fill the doorway's east tile and the inner wall's end; door and window copies enter _Pristine (F-38); the ladder is a real, visible ladder object, with its foot tile rebuilt last (F-39). Run 31 (after run 30: the ladder and doors work, the windows still can't be pathed through, and cars wanted in three places, one on the roof): window copies take bInteractive (F-40); three spawned cars, the roof one in the wing's roof floor cache; the copier logs the 3D cursor's tile. Run 32 (after run 31: the map's own compact gives cover at its tail; the roof car doesn't, and the move range stops a tile short of its nose and tail): the three cars stand on the tile grid as the map's do (F-41). Run 33 (snapping cars to the grid, and an overview shot of the map, zoomed out and well lit, from the front): the spawner snaps cars to the tile grid; the copier pulls the overhead camera out and brightens the picture, for the shot. The overview shot (run 35) is now patchtool's photo object; this spec has none, so normal tests keep the game's camera, lighting and UI.
